text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Around the fourth corner and charging up the hill!
Here begins the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeyaaaaaaaahhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(—I'm okay, I can run!
I've still got more! I can still compete!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah, haa, phew――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I—
I, did it...!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...! I didn't know Tarumae-chan could run looking so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae, seriously...!?
Her ability is completely top-tier now...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You're a locodol, right? Kinda reminds me of Falco-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae...! That was amazing...!
Truly, truly amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...I'll catch up too.
Next year, just like Tarumae... I'll reach Tarumae and the others!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, oh dear.
To think you could shine this brightly...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Especially... Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Acute-san, I'm sorry.
Even though I said that, I still—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(—My legs are still trembling...!
This is the first time... I've ever felt like this
after a run...—)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...!
Standing so tall right after a race like that...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I saw it, Tarumae-chan. Your running.
Your brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to our stage.
Once again, pleased to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come on now.
Show everyone your usual stuff.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I still haven't...!
reached everyone with my voice...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To—!
Flying in from Tomakomai Port, a migratory bird with paper wings!
Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae, is here!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Warm and wonderful town, Tomakomai!!
Please, treat us well, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally starting to sink in.
I really did manage to deliver results...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The way she competed against the elite Senior Class contenders must have left an unforgettable, dazzling impression on the crowd as a dirt racer...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Still, we've only competed against each other in one race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if today went well, there's no telling about next time.
Compared to everyone else,
I still lack fundamental strength...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please let me challenge it again next time!
Give me one more chance to fight on the front lines of dirt...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If we are to learn from today's shortcomings, regroup, and challenge again, the Kawasaki Kinen—with a bit of time in between—would be the most suitable."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The Kawasaki Kinen...
That's the big race that determines
the strongest dirt Umamusume of the new year...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Next time, I need to be more confident—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, our sights were set on our next goal: the Kawasaki Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "—And so, we were all watching Tarumae-chan's race videos together—!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Jeez, are you bringing that up again?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Because that's how thrilling it was!
Saying how amazing you were, starring in such a huge race!"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "Take care of yourself and give it your all, Tarumae-chan! Oh, and Trainer-san, please take good care of her!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Make sure you don't catch a cold either, ma'am.
Well then, see you—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It's been like this ever since
the Champions Cup ended.
choice_data_list: That's just how happy the people of Tomakomai were.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I'm so glad the people of Tomakomai were happy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As Hokko Tarumae said that, an unmistakable shadow
clouded her expression for a moment,
and the reason for it was clear—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Right after the Champions Cup finished,
Hokko Tarumae updated all of her pre-prepared promotional
content for Tomakomai at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We'll also have her reintroduce herself on social media to build major hype, which will then spread to new audiences who came to watch the races and just discovered her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result, as the rising star who ran so well in the Champions Cup,
Hokko Tarumae succeeded in raising her name recognition even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, views on Tomakomai-related content remain
far behind her other local idol posts
and dirt racer content...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, far from it...
The gap in attention compared to other content
had become even more pronounced.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Why... is it like this...?
Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—No.
That's not it...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right now, standing on the front lines,
I've only just begun to get noticed...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
From here on...! 
Things are going to change...!
At the Kawasaki Kinen, I know it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—From that day on, her expression began to show
a shadow from time to time... almost like anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "—Please don't make that face, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was the one who told her that delivering results
at the Champions Cup would definitely change her current situation. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Look, it totally changed!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm receiving more attention right now than ever before, you know? This is truly the fruit of my victory in the Champions Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—That is why Trainer
is not lying.
...They really aren't.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, let's get training started soon.
We have plenty of things to work on
for the Kawasaki Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the girl who still trusts in me,
I have to look ahead and find it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—What I could do if I couldn't reach the future I desired beyond the Kawasaki Kinen."
